posts.title: Studio by Spotify Labs Would Not Name Its Model but Its Log File Did
posts.description: Studio's agent is told never to name its model, even if you try to confirm it. That rule held the whole time. The model identity leaked anyway, out of a log file the rule has no authority over. The gap between those two facts is the story.

posts.title: The Claude Tag Session That Survived a Reinstall
posts.description: One channel's Claude in Slack session pinned a six-day-old connector config and silently ignored every change after it. Removing and reinstalling the app didn't touch it. The rollout turned into a security rebuild.

posts.title: The Way of Code Against Production
posts.description: Rick Rubin rewrote the Tao Te Ching as vibe-coding aphorisms. Some of it maps cleanly to how I build. Some of it falls apart the moment a pager goes off.
